descriptors.definition: Cross-border taxation relies on residence and source principles. Residence taxation taxes individuals based on domicile or companies on place of management, while source taxation taxes income arising within a jurisdiction regardless of residence.
inclusion: Taxation of natural persons based on residence
Taxation of companies based on incorporation or effective management
Taxation of income arising within a country's jurisdiction
exclusion: Domestic-only income transactions without cross-border elements
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between taxpayer location and income generation location

descriptors.definition: An individual's residential status depends on physical stay duration in India during the relevant previous year and preceding years. Citizenship or place of birth does not determine residential status.
inclusion: Stay in territorial waters
Stay on ships or boats moored in Indian territorial waters
Both arrival and departure dates counted as days in India
exclusion: Citizenship as a determinant of tax residency
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes individual residency criteria from corporate residency

descriptors.definition: Specific categories of income earned by non-residents, such as interest on NRE accounts or specified offshore rupee-denominated bonds, are exempt from tax under statutory provisions. These exemptions encourage foreign currency inflows and investments in recognized financial instruments.
inclusion: Interest on NRE bank accounts maintained by non-residents
Interest on specified offshore rupee-denominated bonds
Income of specified funds from transfer of specific assets in IFSC
exclusion: Taxable domestic business income not covered under specific exemptions
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates between fully taxable foreign income and specifically exempted passive inflows

descriptors.concept_name: Presumptive Taxation for Non-Resident Shipping Business
descriptors.definition: Non-residents engaged in the business of operating ships have their profits computed presumptively at a set percentage of gross receipts without standard expense deductions. This mechanism supersedes normal business income computation provisions under specific statutory non-obstante rules.
terminology: Carriage of passengers, livestock, mail or goods
inclusion: Amounts received or deemed to be received for carrying passengers, livestock, mail, or goods
Demurrage and handling charges of a similar nature
exclusion: Cruise shipping businesses referred to in section 44BBC
Standard business expense deductions under sections 28 to 43A
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between standard net income computation and presumptive gross receipt percentage methods

descriptors.definition: Non-residents transferring capital assets in India are subject to capital gains tax, with specific currency fluctuation benefits applied when foreign exchange is invested. Computations require converting consideration, acquisition cost, and transfer expenses into the initial foreign currency used before reconverting the resulting gain into Indian currency.
inclusion: Capital gains from transfer of Indian company shares or debentures acquired in foreign exchange
Conversion using applicable telegraphic transfer rates
exclusion: Indexation benefits for transfers on or after specific statutory dates
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes standard domestic capital gains calculation from foreign currency fluctuation adjusted calculations

descriptors.definition: Chapter XII-A provides specialized taxation rules for non-resident Indians deriving investment income or long-term capital gains from foreign exchange assets. Computation of total income under these provisions restricts standard expenditure deductions and Chapter VI-A deductions under specific conditions.
inclusion: Taxation of investment income on a gross basis without expenditure deductions
Assets acquired through convertible foreign exchange
exclusion: Standard deductions under general provisions where gross total income consists solely of specified investment income
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes general resident taxation rules from NRI-specific Chapter XII-A asset regimes

descriptors.concept_name: Special Tax Rates for Non-Residents and Foreign Companies
descriptors.definition: Specific types of income earned by non-corporate non-residents and foreign companies, such as dividends, interest, and royalties, are taxed at specialized flat statutory rates. These rates vary based on the nature of the borrowing, listing status, and the type of financial instrument utilized.
inclusion: Dividends from units in an IFSC or other entities
Interest received from government or Indian concerns in foreign currency
Distributed income of business trusts from special purpose vehicles
exclusion: General business profits subject to slab or standard corporate tax rates
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes concessional withholding tax rates on foreign borrowings from general domestic interest taxation

descriptors.concept_name: Conversion of Foreign Bank Indian Branch into Subsidiary
descriptors.definition: Capital gains arising when a foreign banking company converts its Indian branch into an Indian subsidiary company under an approved Reserve Bank of India scheme are exempt from tax. This exemption requires the complete transfer of all branch assets and liabilities to the new subsidiary under sanctioned amalgamation terms.
inclusion: Exemption of capital gains on conversion of foreign bank branches
Transfer of all assets and liabilities to the subsidiary
exclusion: Conversions executed outside of Reserve Bank of India regulatory frameworks
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes structural corporate branch reorganizations from standard taxable asset transfers

descriptors.concept_name: Withholding Tax on Non-Resident Salaries and Perquisites
descriptors.definition: Employers must deduct withholding tax at applicable rates on salary payments to non-residents when services are rendered within India. Special provisions govern tax calculation on non-monetary perquisites and allow deferred tax payment timelines for specified startup securities.
inclusion: Salary income deemed to accrue in India due to services rendered locally
Employer payment of tax on non-monetary perquisites without employee deduction
Deferred TDS on specified securities or sweat equity from eligible startups
exclusion: Salaries for services rendered entirely outside India
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes monetary salary withholding from non-monetary perquisite tax handling

descriptors.concept_name: Recovery and Miscellaneous Compliance for Non-Residents
descriptors.definition: Tax authorities can recover unpaid taxes owed by non-residents directly from any of their assets located within India or through international treaty mechanisms involving foreign tax recovery certificates. Additionally, non-residents maintaining liaison offices must submit prescribed periodic statements to tax authorities.
inclusion: Recovery of tax arrears from any assets of the non-resident in India
Cross-border tax recovery enforcement via CBDT and treaty partner nations
Statement submission requirements for non-residents with liaison offices
exclusion: Domestic tax recovery procedures devoid of cross-border or representative elements
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes domestic asset attachment from reciprocal international tax recovery mechanisms
